text:
jamal: quick update — pager went out at 02:14 UTC, we paged db-replica group, failover kicked, customer impact ~3m for writes, read-only degraded for 4m. service restored by 02:18. filing PIR, need facilitator and a recording owner.

elaine: thanks for the summary. I can facilitate if nobody else volunteers. prefer afternoon slot (PST) so we can get EMEA folks too.

priyanka: I can take recording + slides. tagging: @mike for infra context and any runbook gaps.

mike: noted. I'll prepare the failover timeline and the `pg-replica` metrics. can we do the PIR tomorrow? my calendar has free 15:00-16:00 PST.

sre-bot: Incident INC-2026-0315 closed by jamal at 1755550015. Summary: replica lag spike -> leader election -> short write errors.

jamal: re: times — 15:00 PST works for me. Elaine, you ok to facilitate at that time?

elaine: yep that's fine. I'll book a 45-min slot and invite app, infra, support, and CS reps. who from CS should we pull in for customer comms?

priyanka: pull in @ops-manager (their handle for CS liaison), and @carla from account team for the impacted customer. ops-manager: can you make it?

ops-manager: I can join 15:00 PST. Will bring the customer timeline and drafted comms.

jamal: action items so far: 
- facilitator: elaine
- recording/notes: priyanka
- infra runbook + metrics: mike
- customer comms owner: ops-manager
I'll add these to the PIR doc.

priyanka: quick question on scope: should we include a short demo of the failover in the meeting or keep it to timeline/rca/action items? demo might add 10-15m.

mike: demo would be useful to show the exact steps and timings (e.g., `pg_replay`, `pg_promote`). happy to do a 10-min walkthrough if we keep meeting to 60 mins instead of 45.

elaine: let's make it 60. I'll set calendar to 60 and note agenda: 1) timeline & impact 2) root cause hypotheses + logs 3) demo (infra) 4) action items + owners 5) comms.

jamal: who volunteers to own the post-PIR action to update the runbook with clearer promotion checks? sugg: mike or infra eng lead.

mike: I can take the runbook updates (owner until we hand to infra lead). estimate 3-4h of work to add checks + test.

ops-manager: I'll draft the customer-facing message and loop in carla. will post draft to the PIR doc 1h after the meeting.

priyanka: i'll capture notes and add an action tracker table. please use this shorthand when we assign owners: `A1`, `A2`, etc. keeps it easy to reference in comms.

elaine: added preliminary calendar invite (see description link to PIR doc). check availability and RSVP. if you can't make it, please add a short note with your input in the doc before the meeting.

jamal: one more: alerting followup — should we ticket a separate task to tune replica lag alert threshold and add synthetic write checks? I can file or mike can.

mike: I can file the ticket (A3) after the PIR, link to timeline and alerting playbook.

ops-manager: noted. final ask — recording owner remember to upload recording to the incident registry and add transcript. thanks all. :thumbsup:

priyanka: got it. I'll create the entry and add tags `incident`, `pg-failover`, `customer-impact`.

elaine: thanks team. see you tomorrow 15:00 PST. please react with :thumbsup: to confirm.
